body:
I've just installed ART 1.24.3 and was about to resume a project I started in ART 1.24.1 where I had ranked some photos by giving them a star. To quickly find these photos back I pressed the "Show images ranked as 1-star" filter in the file browser, but I got a blank screen (no files shown). I installed ART 1.24.1 again and tried the filter there, and then I indeed got the files that I had ranked earlier. 

**Steps to reproduce (with 1.24.3):**
1. Open a folder with photos
2. Rank a photo with a star
3. Select "Show images ranked as 1-star"

**Expected result:**
The photo with the 1-star ranking is shown

**Actual result:**
No photos are shown

**Last-known working version:**
1.24.1

**First broken version:**
1.24.2

Fiddling a bit more, I found that when filtering on color label in 1.24.1, I got the result as expected (only files shown with selected color label). In 1.24.3, all files were shown regardless the state of the color label filter.
